aura/darksteel-mutation.description: Darksteel Mutation on a flyer: Insect artifact creature 0/1, indestructible, other abilities lost.

aura/kenrith's-transformation.description: Kenrith's Transformation on a 5/5 trampler: green Elk 3/3 with no abilities.

aura/imprisoned-in-the-moon-on-creature.description: Imprisoned in the Moon on a flyer: colorless land with "{T}: Add {C}", no other types or abilities.

aura/song-of-the-dryads-oracle-text.description: Song of the Dryads (current Oracle text: "is a colorless Forest land.") on a flyer.

knownWrong.note: Keeps Flying and is not marked as having lost its abilities. CR 305.7: setting a basic land type removes the abilities from its rules text; CR 205.1a: the new card type replaces Creature.

aura/forest-land-explicit-wording.description: Synthetic Song-style Aura that spells out "loses all other card types and abilities".

aura/timestamps-mutation-then-forest.description: Darksteel Mutation (earlier) then the Forest-land Aura (later) on the same creature: later wins in layer 4.

aura/mutation-then-kenrith.description: Darksteel Mutation then Kenrith's Transformation on the same creature (two type + base P/T setters).

abilities/aura-on-lord.description: An Aura that removes all abilities from an Elf lord: the lord bonus stops applying.

abilities/humility.description: Humility with a flyer, a trampler, an Elf lord and its Elf, and a creature with +1/+1 counters.

abilities/dress-down.description: Dress Down ("Creatures lose all abilities.") with a flyer and an Elf lord.

abilities/anthem-before-humility.description: An anthem enchantment, then Humility: 7b sets 1/1, 7c adds +1/+1 whatever the timestamps.

opalescence/basic.description: Opalescence animates other non-Aura enchantments (base P/T = mana value), not Auras or itself.

opalescence/humility-first.description: Humility (earlier) then Opalescence (later). Oracle ruling: Humility and the other enchantment are 4/4 and 3/3 (their mana values); other creatures are 1/1; all creatures lose their abilities.

opalescence/opalescence-first.description: Opalescence (earlier) then Humility (later). Oracle ruling: every creature, including the animated enchantments, is 1/1 with no abilities.

opalescence/forest-land-on-animated-ench.description: The explicit Forest-land Aura on an Opalescence-animated enchantment: it is only a land.

opalescence/song-of-the-dryads-on-animat.description: Song of the Dryads (Oracle text) on an Opalescence-animated enchantment.

knownWrong.note: Not marked as having lost its rules-text abilities. CR 305.7 removes them when Song sets the Forest land type.

removal/archetype-of-imagination.description: Archetype of Imagination: its controller's creatures fly; opponents' creatures lose flying, innate or granted by Equipment.

instance/counters-pumps-switch.description: +1/+1 and -1/-1 counters, a temporary pump, and a P/T switch (7d) applied after an anthem (7c).

instance/granted-keyword-attribution.description: Temporary granted keywords are attributed to a permanent whose text "gains" that keyword, else to "Temporary Effect".

instance/phased-out.description: Phased-out sources apply nothing (an anthem, Humility); a phased-out creature reports its printed values.

instance/copy-effect.description: Layer 1: a Clone copying the Elf lord; each lord pumps the other and the Elf gets both bonuses.
